co.name: Company name
co.nameHint: The company name comes from Admin (Company › Profile); change it there.
co.logoHint: PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP, square, up to 1 MB. Without a logo the first letter of the company name is used.
co.ownHint: Used to tell whether a contract is a purchase or a sale: which party is our company.
co.taxInvalid: Tax codes must have 10 or 13 digits
co.stockOverOn: On: confirming a delivery is not blocked when stock is short; stock may go negative and a "delivered beyond stock" warning is shown.
co.stockOverOff: Off: a delivery cannot be confirmed when stock is short.
co.coverHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, about 4:1 (e.g. 1600×400), up to 3 MB. Shown at the top of the company profile in the Feed; without one the primary colour is used.
co.coverType: Only PNG, JPG or WebP images are accepted
co.accentLow: Colour too light: contrast with white text is only {{ratio}}:1, it must be at least 4.5:1 so button text and links stay readable.
co.accentBad: The custom colour is not valid — fix the code (#RRGGBB, dark enough for white text) or pick a preset colour.

biz.title: Business score
biz.sub: Suggestions to buy more, hold or dump stock on the Products & Prices page.
biz.f1: Score = Σ (factor × weight) ÷ Σ weights of factors that have data.
biz.f2: Stock: sales speed = 100 − (days of stock − 30) ÷ 1.5; packages: seats expected to sell before expiry ÷ seats held.
biz.f3: Margin ×400 (25% = 100); trend = 50 + (last 3 months − previous 3 months) ÷ previous 3 months × 50.
biz.f4: Holding stock: Buy more / Hold / Dump; not holding: Push / Keep / Consider stopping.

score.title: Reputation score

err.sum: Weights of enabled criteria must total exactly 100%.
err.order: Good level must be above Fair level (1–100).
err.window: Window is 1–60 months; the recent period cannot exceed the window.
err.manual: Manual-rating criteria are closed (no star input) — turn them off before saving.
